item.title: Please Allow Ads on Shiguangji
item.description:
A simple change in your browser settings can make a real difference to the future of this website.

Shiguangji is currently supported mainly by advertising revenue.

That revenue helps cover the everyday costs of running the website, including hosting, domain renewal, software testing, content research, technical maintenance, and the continued publication of free articles.

We want to keep most of the content on this website freely available without placing everything behind a paywall or requiring visitors to purchase a membership.

For that reason, if you are using an ad-blocking extension, we sincerely invite you to add Shiguangji to your allowlist.

You do not need to disable your ad blocker on every website. Allowing ads only on Shiguangji is enough to support the site while keeping your usual protection elsewhere.

Why Advertising Matters to Shiguangji

Every tutorial, tool review, project note, and troubleshooting guide requires time, testing, research, and ongoing maintenance.

Advertising revenue helps support:

  • Website hosting and network services
  • Domain renewal and technical maintenance
  • Software, tools, and service testing
  • Article research, editing, and updates
  • Website development and security
  • The continued publication of free content

For you, allowing ads may take only a few seconds.

For Shiguangji, that small action helps turn free visits into sustainable support for future content.

About the Ads Displayed on This Website

Shiguangji uses Google AdSense to provide advertising.

Google AdSense is an advertising service operated by Google for website publishers. Advertisements delivered through the platform are subject to Google’s advertising policies, technical standards, and review systems.

Shiguangji may also use the management and review tools provided by Google AdSense to monitor, block, or report unsuitable advertisements.

We make reasonable efforts to reduce advertisements that may be:

  • Misleading
  • Irrelevant to the website
  • Disruptive to normal reading
  • Inappropriate or uncomfortable
  • Potentially inconsistent with platform policies

However, advertisements are delivered dynamically based on factors such as your location, device, browsing environment, page content, and advertising preferences.

Because of this, Shiguangji cannot review every advertisement before it appears to every visitor.

If you notice an advertisement that appears inappropriate, misleading, or suspicious, please contact us and include a screenshot and the page URL whenever possible. We will review the issue and take appropriate action through the available advertising controls.

You Do Not Need to Disable Your Ad Blocker Everywhere

To protect your browsing preferences and security, we recommend adding Shiguangji to your allowlist instead of disabling your ad blocker globally.

After adding the site to your allowlist:

  • Your ad blocker will continue working on other websites
  • Ads will only be permitted on Shiguangji
  • You can restore blocking for this website at any time
  • You do not need to uninstall any browser extension

After changing the setting, please refresh the current page.

Google Chrome Instructions

Method 1: Allow Ads Through the Extension Icon

This is usually the easiest and most convenient method.

  1. Open Shiguangji in Google Chrome.
  2. Click the Extensions icon in the upper-right corner of the browser.
  3. Find the ad-blocking extension you are using.
  4. Click the extension icon to open its control panel.
  5. Select an option such as:
    • Pause on this site
    • Allow ads on this site
    • Trust this site
    • Add to allowlist
  6. Refresh the page.

The exact wording may vary depending on the extension, but most ad blockers provide an option to disable blocking for the current website only.

Method 2: Temporarily Disable the Extension

If you are not sure which extension is blocking the ads, you can temporarily disable the relevant extension.

  1. Open Google Chrome.
  2. Click the three-dot menu in the upper-right corner.
  3. Select Extensions.
  4. Open Manage Extensions.
  5. Find the ad-blocking extension.
  6. Turn off the extension using the switch.
  7. Return to Shiguangji and refresh the page.

You can also enter the following address directly into the browser:

chrome://extensions/

Then press Enter.

Please note that this method disables the extension on all websites until you turn it back on.

Instructions for Common Ad-Blocking Extensions

AdBlock

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the AdBlock icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Select the option that allows ads on the current website.
  4. Confirm the change if prompted.
  5. Refresh the page.

Depending on the version, the option may appear as:

  • Allow ads on this site
  • Pause on this site
  • Always allow ads on this site
  • Add to allowlist

Choose the option that applies only to the current website.

Adblock Plus

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the Adblock Plus icon in the browser toolbar.
  3. Open the extension settings.
  4. Find the list of allowed websites.
  5. Add the Shiguangji domain.
  6. Save the setting and refresh the page.

Some versions also provide a switch labeled:

This website

or:

Block ads on this website

Turn off blocking for the current website only.

uBlock Origin

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the uBlock Origin icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Click the large power button in the extension panel.
  4. Confirm that the power button changes to the disabled state.
  5. Refresh the page.

This setting normally applies only to the current website.

Click the power button again if you later want to restore blocking on Shiguangji.

uBlock Origin Lite

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the uBlock Origin Lite icon.
  3. Find the filtering level for the current website.
  4. Change the filtering setting to:

No filtering

  1. Refresh the page.

This change normally applies only to the current website and does not affect filtering on other websites.

AdGuard AdBlocker

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the AdGuard icon in the Chrome toolbar.
  3. Find the option related to filtering on the current website.
  4. Turn off filtering for Shiguangji.
  5. Refresh the page.

You may also open the AdGuard settings and add Shiguangji to the:

Allowlist

After that, AdGuard will continue working normally on other websites.

Ghostery

  1. Open Shiguangji.
  2. Click the Ghostery icon in the browser toolbar.
  3. Choose to pause protection or trust the current website.
  4. Select a permanent option such as:

Always

or:

Always trust this site

  1. Refresh the page.

Ghostery will continue protecting you on other websites while allowing Shiguangji to display ads.

Built-In Browser Ad Blocking

Some Chromium-based browsers include their own advertising, tracking, or privacy protection features.

If you have not installed an ad-blocking extension but still see a warning that ads are blocked, look near the address bar for:

  • An ad-blocking notice
  • A shield icon
  • A privacy protection icon
  • A tracking protection message
  • A blocked content notification

Click the relevant icon and allow advertising or disable protection for the current website, then refresh the page.

Still Not Working?

If you have already added Shiguangji to your allowlist but the website still reports that ads are blocked, try the following steps.

1. Refresh the Page

After changing the settings, perform a full refresh.

On Windows, press:

Ctrl + F5

On macOS, press:

Command + Shift + R

2. Check for Multiple Blocking Extensions

Some users have more than one advertising, privacy, script, or tracking extension installed.

Examples include:

  • AdBlock
  • Adblock Plus
  • uBlock Origin
  • uBlock Origin Lite
  • AdGuard
  • Ghostery
  • Privacy Badger
  • NoScript
  • Browser privacy extensions

Even if one extension allows Shiguangji, another extension may continue blocking advertising.

Please check each relevant extension and add the website to its allowlist.

3. Check Security Software or DNS Filtering

Advertisements may also be blocked by software or services outside the browser.

Common examples include:

  • Antivirus web protection
  • Router-level ad blocking
  • AdGuard DNS
  • NextDNS
  • Pi-hole
  • Proxy or filtering rules
  • Company or school network policies
  • Privacy-focused DNS services

If you have disabled your browser extensions but the warning remains, one of these services may be responsible.

4. Clear Cache and Cookies

You may also try clearing the cache and cookies for the current website and then reopening the page.

Please note that clearing cookies may sign you out or reset certain website preferences.

Thank You for Supporting Shiguangji

Shiguangji aims to keep most of its content free and accessible while avoiding advertising formats that seriously interfere with reading.

We understand that everyone has different browsing habits, and we respect your decision about whether to use an ad blocker.

Still, allowing ads on Shiguangji is one of the most direct and practical ways to support the website.

Every visit, article view, and share helps Shiguangji continue publishing useful content.

Free content is not free to produce. It simply means someone else is covering the cost.

Thank you for supporting Shiguangji.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 21, 2026

We value the privacy and security of every visitor to this website.

This Privacy Policy explains what information may be collected when you visit or use Tood.win, how that information may be used, and the choices available to you regarding your privacy.

1. Information We May Collect

When you browse this website or interact with us, certain information may be collected.

Information You Provide Voluntarily

If you contact us through comments, forms, or email, you may choose to provide information such as:

  • Your name or nickname
  • Your email address
  • Messages, comments, or inquiry details
  • Any other information you choose to provide

Please do not submit sensitive information, such as government identification numbers, bank card details, account passwords, or similar confidential data through public comment areas.

Information Collected Automatically

To keep the website operating properly, understand how it is used, improve performance, and maintain security, our servers or third-party service providers may automatically collect certain technical information, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser and operating system
  • Device type and basic device information
  • Date and time of access
  • Referring source and pages visited
  • Time spent on pages and basic interaction data

This information is generally used for analytics, troubleshooting, performance monitoring, and security purposes. It is not normally used by us to directly identify you as an individual.

2. Cookies and Similar Technologies

This website may use cookies, local storage, and similar technologies to:

  • Remember necessary website preferences
  • Measure website traffic and usage
  • Improve page performance and browsing experience
  • Measure advertising and promotional performance
  • Provide more relevant content or advertising where permitted and where consent has been obtained

You can usually view, delete, block, or restrict cookies through your browser settings.

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect some website features, advertising preferences, or the overall browsing experience.

3. Third-Party Advertising

To help support the operation of this website, Tood.win may use third-party advertising services, including Google AdSense.

When you visit a page that contains advertising, Google and its advertising technology partners may receive certain information necessary to deliver and measure advertisements, such as:

  • The URL of the page you are visiting
  • Your IP address
  • Browser and device information
  • Data relating to ad impressions, interactions, clicks, or performance measurement

Google and its partners may use cookies or similar technologies to measure advertising performance.

Where required by applicable law, information will only be used for personalized advertising after appropriate consent has been obtained.

You may also be able to manage your advertising preferences through the privacy and advertising controls provided by Google.

4. Affiliate Links and Promotions

Some articles on this website may contain affiliate links, referral links, or promotional links to third-party products and services, including services such as Airalo, Spaceship, and Vultr.

If you register, purchase, or subscribe through one of these links, we may receive a referral commission.

In most cases, this commission is paid by the service provider and does not increase the price you pay.

We aim to recommend products and services based on actual experience, usefulness, or relevance to the content. However, pricing, availability, features, terms, and service quality are controlled by the relevant third-party provider.

5. How We Use Information

Information collected through this website may be used to:

  • Operate, maintain, and improve the website
  • Understand website traffic and content usage
  • Improve navigation, layout, and user experience
  • Respond to questions, suggestions, or collaboration inquiries
  • Prevent spam, abuse, fraud, and security threats
  • Measure advertising and promotional performance
  • Meet applicable legal or regulatory obligations
  • Protect the rights, safety, and legitimate interests of the website operator, users, and other relevant parties

We do not intend to use personal information for purposes that are materially unrelated to those described above.

6. Sharing and Disclosure of Information

We do not sell personal information to third parties.

However, certain information may be shared or disclosed in limited circumstances, including where:

  • You have provided clear consent or authorization
  • Third-party services are needed for hosting, analytics, advertising, security, or website functionality
  • Sharing is necessary to respond to a request you have submitted
  • Disclosure is required by law, regulation, court order, or a competent authority
  • Disclosure is reasonably necessary to protect the rights, safety, or security of the website, its users, or other parties

Third-party service providers may process information under their own privacy policies and terms.

7. Users in the EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, your personal information may be processed in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Where required, we may ask for your consent before using non-essential cookies or processing information for personalized advertising.

You may be able to review, change, or withdraw your consent at any time through the privacy or consent management tools available on the website.

Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.

8. Privacy Rights for Residents of Certain U.S. States

If you live in California or another U.S. state with applicable consumer privacy laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.

Depending on your location and the applicable law, these rights may include the ability to:

  • Request information about the personal data we collect or process
  • Request correction of inaccurate personal information
  • Request deletion of eligible personal information
  • Learn whether personal information is shared or used for targeted advertising
  • Limit certain uses or processing of personal information
  • Opt out of certain types of advertising-related data processing

The specific rights available to you and the conditions that apply may vary depending on your jurisdiction.

9. Third-Party Links

This website may contain links to third-party websites, products, platforms, or services.

Once you leave Tood.win and access a third-party website, your activity is governed by that third party’s own terms of service and privacy policy.

We do not control how third-party websites collect, use, share, or retain your information.

We recommend reviewing the privacy policy of any external service before providing personal information or using its features.

10. Data Retention and Security

We may retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for website operation, communication, legal compliance, fraud prevention, security, and other legitimate purposes.

We take reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against:

  • Unauthorized access
  • Unlawful use or disclosure
  • Accidental loss or damage
  • Malicious attacks or unauthorized modification

However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

For this reason, we cannot guarantee that information will remain entirely free from security risks in all circumstances.

11. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live and the laws that apply, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal information
  • Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
  • Request deletion of certain personal information
  • Restrict or object to certain types of processing
  • Withdraw consent previously given
  • Request a copy of eligible personal information

To submit a privacy-related request, please contact us at:

Email: admin@tood.win

To protect personal information, we may ask for reasonable verification of your identity or the authenticity of your request before taking action.

12. Children’s Privacy

This website is intended for a general internet audience and is not specifically directed at children.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below the age at which parental consent is required under applicable law.

If you believe that a child has submitted personal information to this website without appropriate parental or guardian consent, please contact us. We will review the matter and take appropriate action where necessary.

13. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes to website features, third-party services, business practices, or legal requirements.

Any updated version will be published on this page, and the Last updated date at the top of the page will be revised accordingly.

We encourage you to review this page periodically to stay informed about how information is handled.

14. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, our use of cookies, or how personal information is handled, please contact us by email:

Email: admin@tood.win

We take legitimate privacy questions and requests seriously and will review them within a reasonable scope.

item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Bruce.

I’m a curious builder who enjoys exploring new technology, useful tools, and interesting products across the web.

Over the years, I’ve spent a lot of time building websites, experimenting with small web projects, managing domains and VPS servers, testing AI tools, exploring open-source software, and setting up all kinds of local applications.

What I enjoy most is the process itself: starting with an idea, figuring out how things work, running into problems, trying different approaches, and eventually getting everything working the way it should.

About This Site

This website is where I document what I learn along the way.

You’ll mainly find:

  • Tools and software I’ve actually used
  • Projects I’ve built or experimented with
  • Problems I’ve encountered in real-world use
  • Mistakes, limitations, and unexpected issues
  • Solutions and workflows I’ve personally tested

The goal isn’t to make things sound more complicated than they are.

I prefer content that is:

practical, clear, honest, and easy to follow.

Whenever possible, I focus on what actually works rather than just repeating documentation or theory.

Why I Write

A problem often looks simple once you know the answer.

Sometimes the final solution is just one setting, one command, or a few lines of code.

Getting there, however, can mean reading through documentation, searching forums, testing multiple approaches, dealing with outdated information, and losing hours to one tiny detail.

That’s why I started documenting these experiences.

Hopefully, the things I learn can help someone else:

  • Save a little time
  • Avoid unnecessary trial and error
  • Solve a problem faster
  • Discover a useful tool or idea worth exploring

If something I’ve written here helps you solve a problem or gives you a better starting point, then this site has done its job.

Get in Touch

If you have a question, suggestion, correction, or simply want to exchange ideas, feel free to reach out.

Email: admin@tood.win

Stay curious. Keep building. Explore · Build · Share
